h1: Avana Bangkok Hotel — an outdoor pool in the heart of Bang Na, with a full convention centre and a free BITEC shuttle
intro: If you are heading to an exhibition at BITEC Bang Na and need a four-star base with an outdoor pool, spa and on-site convention facilities, Avana Bangkok Hotel & Convention Centre has been one of Bang Na's most established hotel options for years. The hotel sits on Debaratna Road in Bangna Tai, about 1.9 km from BITEC, and runs a free shuttle to both BITEC and BTS Bang Na station — a practical lifeline given the distance from the main road. The property has 185 rooms all with private balconies, an outdoor pool with a children's zone, a spa, fitness centre, tennis court, restaurant, bar and free parking. Scored 7.4 from 35 Trip.com reviews, with service rated at 8.1 (staff are a consistent highlight). Rooms start from approx. THB 1,200/night in standard periods, rising during major BITEC events.

body.html: Avana Bangkok Hotel & Convention Centre has carved out a niche as Bang Na's go-to base for trade shows, conferences and corporate groups heading to BITEC. The in-house convention facilities handle everything from small boardrooms to larger banqueting events, and the events team receives consistent praise in reviews for their coordination. The free shuttle to BITEC is the feature that appears most frequently in guest comments — and it matters, because walking from the hotel to the main road is not particularly easy.

All 185 rooms include a private balcony, air conditioning, flat-screen TV, mini-fridge and free Wi-Fi. The most commonly praised features are room size, cleanliness and the quality of the beds. The 28 sq-m Deluxe rooms come with a King or Twin bed and a balcony looking out over the grounds. The 60 sq-m Junior Suite adds a separate sitting area, making it a reasonable option for extended stays or families needing extra space.
"Spacious, clean and very quiet. The shuttle to BITEC ran on time every trip. Staff were genuinely helpful throughout."

The outdoor pool with a children's zone is a genuine draw for families, particularly during weekends when the grounds are quieter than on conference weekdays. A spa offering massages and wellness treatments, a fitness centre with modern equipment, and a tennis court give the hotel a breadth of leisure facilities that most Bang Na properties do not match. Breakfast is a buffet with Chinese, American and Asian options — available at an additional charge for guests on room-only rates.

Honesty requires noting that the building is ageing. Several reviews mention cracks in corridor walls, outdated furnishings in common areas, and occasional air-conditioning units that are noisy or inconsistent. The Trip.com breakdown tells the story clearly: service scores 8.1 (staff are a strong point), but facilities score 7.0 and location 6.7. The property delivers comfort and value, but not the polished finish of a newer four-star.

Bang Na itself has become a far more interesting destination than its industrial-corridor reputation suggests. Bangkok Mall — claimed as the largest shopping complex in Southeast Asia — has opened nearby. Mega Bangna and IKEA are a short ride away, as is Central Bangna. The district also sits at the gateway to Suvarnabhumi Airport (about 20 minutes by car), and the expressway network makes day trips to Bang Phli and Chon Buri straightforward. For drivers, Bang Na is genuinely convenient.

In summary, Avana Bangkok Hotel is a solid choice for BITEC event-goers, corporate groups and families wanting pool access and free parking at a fair four-star price. If you are a leisure traveller prioritising a modern-looking property or easy BTS access, you will likely find better options elsewhere in the roundup. But on its own terms — facilities volume, shuttle service and room size for the price — the hotel earns its place in Bang Na's top ten.

highlights.title: Free Shuttle to BITEC & BTS
highlights.text: A free hotel shuttle runs to both BITEC Bang Na exhibition centre and BTS Bang Na station — essential when the hotel's own entrance road adds extra distance from the main arterial.

highlights.title: Outdoor Pool + Spa
highlights.text: An outdoor pool with a children's zone, a spa, fitness centre and tennis court put Avana's leisure offering ahead of most Bang Na competitors at this price point.

highlights.title: In-House Convention Centre
highlights.text: Ballroom and meeting rooms in multiple sizes handle corporate events end-to-end. The events team is praised in reviews for logistics coordination during trade shows and conferences.

honestSummary: Avana Bangkok Hotel is old but still worthwhile for the right traveller — BITEC visitors who need a free shuttle and parking, corporate groups, or families wanting a pool at a fair price. If you are expecting a freshly renovated four-star with modern design, this property is likely to disappoint.
honestChecks: If you want a modern, design-forward four-star — Avana Bangkok's building age shows, and common areas need refurbishment. Consider Thomson Hotels or Lasalle Suites in this roundup instead.
If you plan to use the BTS Skytrain as your main transport — BTS Bang Na is about 1.7 km away with no easy walking route. Every trip will require the hotel shuttle or a Grab ride.

If you are attending a BITEC event, a conference or a trade show — this is one of the best-equipped options in Bang Na: free shuttle, on-site convention facilities, large free parking and reasonable room rates make it a natural fit.

tips.title: Book the shuttle the night before
tips.body: Tell the front desk your BITEC or BTS shuttle schedule when you check in. During major trade shows the shuttle fills fast — advance notice means a guaranteed seat at your preferred time.

tips.title: The pool is best at 7–9 am
tips.body: The outdoor pool is almost empty in the early morning before conference guests surface. A quiet, uncrowded swim in pleasant Bangkok morning air is one of the hotel's genuine pleasures.

tips.title: Mega Bangna + IKEA within five minutes
tips.body: Mega Bangna (including IKEA) is just a few minutes by car or Grab. A practical stop for groceries, snacks or a casual meal without going into central Bangkok.

tips.title: Request a higher floor for better views
tips.body: Upper-floor rooms are quieter and offer wider views over the Bang Na district. Request one at the time of booking or during check-in — there is usually no extra charge.

faqTitle: FAQ — Avana Bangkok Hotel Bang Na

faq.q: Where is Avana Bangkok Hotel located and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 906 Debaratna Road, Bangna Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260. BITEC Bang Na is about 1.9 km away (free hotel shuttle). BTS Bang Na station is about 1.7 km (free shuttle). Mega Bangna and IKEA are about 5 minutes by car. Suvarnabhumi Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

faq.q: What are room prices at Avana Bangkok Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. THB 1,200–1,500/night for a Trendy Single or Deluxe Twin room in standard periods. Prices rise significantly during major BITEC trade shows. The Junior Suite (60 sq m) starts from around THB 2,800. Always compare prices across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Avana Bangkok Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — there is an outdoor pool with a children's zone, surrounded by garden areas. The hotel also has a spa, fitness centre with modern equipment, and a tennis court.

faq.q: Is Avana Bangkok Hotel suitable for BITEC trade shows?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the best-suited options in Bang Na for BITEC visitors — free shuttle to the exhibition centre, large free parking, on-site convention facilities, and reasonably priced rooms are the main draws for trade show and conference attendees.

faq.q: Is there free parking at Avana Bangkok Hotel?
faq.a: Yes — there is a large free on-site car park, which is a notable advantage for visitors driving from provincial areas or other parts of Bangkok.
